article.story: CHATTANOOGA, Tenn. -- — Travis Harper II and Aaron Nkrumah had 17 points apiece in Tennessee State's 70-64 victory against Chattanooga on Sunday. Harper had six rebounds for the Tigers (5-3). Dante Harris finished 6 of 11 from the field to finish with 15 points. The Mocs (4-4) were led in scoring by Tate Darner, who finished with 16 points. Billy Smith added 11 points for Chattanooga. Sebastian Hartmann finished with nine points and eight rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
